title: API Metrics
description: API metrics with number of requests, errors, most requested endpoints, etc

panels.title: Number of Requests

queries.query:
SELECT count(*) AS requests
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" %'

panels.title: Requests time

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis, count(*) AS requests
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" %'
GROUP BY x_axis
ORDER BY x_axis

panels.title: Requests by Status Code

queries.query:
SELECT regexp_match(log, 'HTTP/1.1" (\d{3})')[1] AS status,
       count(*) AS requests
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" %'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

panels.title: 5xx over time

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis,
       regexp_match(log, 'HTTP/1.1" (\d{3})')[1] AS status,
       count(*) AS errors
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 5__ %'
GROUP BY x_axis, status
ORDER BY x_axis

panels.title: Endpoints with most errors

queries.query:
SELECT regexp_match(log, '"(\w+) ')[1] AS method,
       regexp_match(log, '"\w+ ([^ ?]+)')[1] AS path,
       regexp_match(log, 'HTTP/1.1" (\d{3})')[1] AS status,
       count(*) AS errors
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 4__ %' OR log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 5__ %'
GROUP BY method, path, status
ORDER BY errors DESC

panels.title: 4xx by status code

queries.query:
SELECT regexp_match(log, 'HTTP/1.1" (\d{3})')[1] AS status,
       count(*) AS errors
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 4__ %'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

panels.title: Errors by image version

queries.query:
SELECT kubernetes_container_image AS image,
       count(*) AS requests,
       sum(CASE WHEN log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 5__ %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors_5xx,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 5__ %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 2) AS error_rate_5xx_pct
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" %'
GROUP BY image
ORDER BY image DESC

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate

queries.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
         round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" 5__ %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2),
         0) AS error_rate_5xx_pct
FROM fintracker_api
WHERE log LIKE '%HTTP/1.1" %'
